ANNEXURE - I : GENERAL TERMS & CONDITIONS OF PURCHASE ORDER

1. SCOPE OF SUPPLY:
The Supplier shall supply the Solar PV materials / equipment strictly in accordance with the technical specifications, make, and quantities specified in this Purchase Order.

2. QUALITY & STANDARDS:
All materials supplied against this Purchase Order must be brand new, unused, and conform to relevant MNRE / IEC / BIS / ISI standards. Test certificates and warranty certificates shall be furnished along with the dispatch documents.

3. PACKAGING & DISPATCH:
Materials shall be securely packed to prevent any transit damage. Each consignment must be accompanied by Tax Invoice, Delivery Challan, E-Way Bill, and Packing List clearly mentioning our Purchase Order Number.

4. INSPECTION & REJECTION:
All materials are subject to inspection and verification at the delivery site / warehouse by Sathlokhar Synergys E&C Global Limited. Any defective, damaged, or non-conforming materials shall be replaced by the Supplier immediately at their own cost.

5. DELIVERY SCHEDULE & LIQUIDATED DAMAGES:
Time is the essence of this Purchase Order. Delivery must be completed within the stipulated delivery schedule mentioned on Page 1. Any delay in delivery without prior written approval may attract liquidated damages.

6. WARRANTY & GUARANTEE:
The Supplier warrants that all goods supplied under this Purchase Order shall be free from defects in design, material, and workmanship for the standard manufacturer warranty period from the date of commissioning or supply.

7. INVOICING & PAYMENT TERMS:
Original Tax Invoices mentioning GSTIN 33AACCL5566B1ZT and the Purchase Order Number must be submitted to our Accounts Department. Payment shall be processed as per the agreed credit terms specified in this Purchase Order.

8. JURISDICTION:
Any disputes arising out of or in connection with this Purchase Order shall be subject to the exclusive jurisdiction of the Courts at Chennai, Tamil Nadu.

ANNEXURE - I : GENERAL TERMS & CONDITIONS OF WORK ORDER

1. SCOPE OF WORK:
The Contractor shall execute the Solar PV installation, structure erection, electrical cabling, earthing, and commissioning works strictly as per the approved drawings and instructions of our Site Engineer.

2. SAFETY & WORKMANSHIP:
The Contractor must ensure that all workmen wear required Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) including safety helmets, safety shoes, and safety harnesses during rooftop work. Workmanship shall be neat, plumb, and compliant with CEIG / TANGEDCO safety norms.

3. TOOLS, TACKLES & CONSUMABLES:
All necessary tools, drilling machines, crimping tools, testing instruments, and manpower required for executing the work are in the Contractor's scope.

4. SITE CLEARANCE & HANDOVER:
Upon completion of installation, the Contractor shall clear all debris, test the system string voltages and earthing continuity, and hand over the site with joint measurement certification signed by the Project Engineer.

5. DEFECT LIABILITY:
Any installation defects, loose terminations, or water leakage caused during structure mounting shall be rectified by the Contractor free of cost within the defect liability period.

6. BILLING & PAYMENT:
Bills must be submitted along with the Work Completion Certificate signed by the Site Engineer and Project Manager. Statutory TDS deductions as applicable under the Income Tax Act shall be made.

7. JURISDICTION:
All disputes arising out of this Work Order shall be subject to the exclusive jurisdiction of the Courts at Chennai, Tamil Nadu.
